notes.note: Cross-station reads now state the owner-only admission for both remote reads (bound owner, current principal, no agent origin or internal token; fail closed without composed authority), hosted refusal with the withdrawn remoteSessionHistory flag, the 262,144-byte response ceiling, and that the session summary and events are relayed as the remote returned them. Checked against ssh-environments.ts refuseRemoteRead, runtime-routes.ts wiring, remote-session-reader.ts and their tests.

Added that only the Station's owner in person sees remote sessions (other people's paired devices and agents are refused) and that a hosted Station offers neither the list nor the reader. Checked against ssh-environments.ts and runtime-routes.ts.

Remote session history now lists the too-large and Forbidden outcomes, and documents StationResponseTooLargeError (client export) and its use as the cause of orchestration readers' unreadable-body error; checked against bounded-response.ts, orchestration.ts and client/index.ts. The existing maxResponseBytes probe text elsewhere is unchanged and still accurate.
